title: Dhatuplikti Churna
description: Dhatuplikti Churna (Dhatu Pushti Churna) is a highly nourishing formulation intended to replenish vital structural fluids (Dhatus) and supporting tissues. This classical formulation overcomes physical weakness through comprehensive tissue nourishment. Addresses oligospermia (low sperm count) through tissue rejuvenation and sperm-producing tissue enhancement. Helps under-weight individuals gain healthy mass through improved nutrient absorption and assimilation. Counters general fatigue through tissue rejuvenation and energy restoration.
